name: Hull Patty
desc: Mashed potato and sage, battered and fried golden in a Hull chippy. Put it in a bread cake and it's a pattie butty. Restores 120 HP.

name: Lincolnshire Sausage
desc: Coarse-cut pork with a good fistful of sage, the way Lincolnshire butchers have made it for generations. Restores 150 HP.

name: Lincolnshire Plum Bread
desc: A fruit loaf with not one plum in it: 'plums' meant any dried fruit. Eat it sliced and buttered with a wedge of Lincolnshire Poacher cheese. Restores 15 PP to every move.

name: Lincoln Imp Pin
desc: A little gilt Imp with one leg crossed. A Lincoln jeweller, James Ward Usher, made them a craze in Victorian times and left his fortune to build the city an art gallery.
msg: {name}'s Lincoln Imp Pin gave it a cheeky edge!

name: Fisherman's Gansey
desc: A tight-knit jumper of oiled navy wool, in a Hull pattern. Every port knitted its own, so the sea could never take a man without a name.

name: Wolds Flint
desc: A knobbly nodule from the Wolds chalk, white-crusted and glassy black inside. Turned up by the plough every winter, and by Stone Age toolmakers long before.

name: Abolition Petition
desc: A petition to Parliament against the slave trade, from Wilberforce House in Hull. It asks for three names, and the ink is still wet.
